intent: Eight individual digital-tool tasks preserve frequency, instructions, conditions, limited comparisons, missing paper and a restricted print request.
picturePurpose: Original desktop/laptop picture supports two real form choices; weight and habitual carriage come from the source, never appearance. A coded six-page selector makes only the pages you need operational without executing printing or claiming a completed job.

items.label: computer：电脑多久保存一次备份？
items.prompt: 电脑多久保存一次备份？
items.material: The computer saves a backup every hour.
items.reason: computer表示计算机。every hour是每小时，不是每天，也不是一直不停地保存。saves a backup报告备份保存的习惯，没有说已经测试所有文件能否恢复，也没有说明备份存在哪里。
items.hint: 看every hour；保存不等于恢复验证。

transfer.stem: Which notes keep the backup frequency, comparison and page requirement?
transfer.passage:
Preparing our club display
The computer saves a backup every hour. We still need to test whether our saved files can be restored. My laptop is light enough to carry daily, but this note does not say I actually carry it every day.
Keep drinks away from the keyboard. The screen is hard to read in sunlight. Our new monitor uses less electricity than the old one; we did not compare every model.
The printer has run out of paper. Our six-page file needs only pages 2 and 4 for the display. Please print those pages after adding paper. Selecting the pages is not the same as finishing the print job.

options.text: Backups are hourly; the monitor is compared with the old one; only pages 2 and 4 are needed.
Backups are daily; the monitor is compared with the old one; only pages 2 and 4 are needed.
Backups are hourly; the monitor uses less electricity than every model; only pages 2 and 4 are needed.
Backups are hourly; the monitor is compared with the old one; all six pages are needed.

answer.display: Backups are hourly; the monitor is compared with the old one; only pages 2 and 4 are needed.

explanation.strategy: 依次核对备份频率、比较对象和只需要的页。

steps.text: 备份是每小时一次；显示器只与旧的那台相比，没有比较所有型号。
steps.reason: every hour限定频率；than the old one和did not compare every model限定比较范围。

steps.text: 六页文件只需要第2和第4页，多打其他页不符合要求。
steps.reason: only pages 2 and 4限制页码；选择页面不等于已经完成打印。

distractors.reason: 把每小时every hour换成每天daily。
把旧显示器这一比较对象扩大成所有型号。
忽略only，把两页扩大成六页全选。

explanation.pitfall: 把小时换成天，把一个比较对象换成全部，把only需要的页换成整份文件。

visual.caption: 先核对限定词，再看是否多加结论。
